I replied to Pree in our DM. I found three ticket numbers that are clearly Marrow Fieldworks, plus one that might be:

- **#4409**: from Moss's Central handoffs digest (2 Jan 2026). A report keeps timing out at the Salina North yard.
- **#4412**: from the same digest. A small glitch in the text prompts drivers get.
- **PD-5302**: from #central-random, where Hollis posted it on 14 Oct as a follow-up from this week.
- **#8841 (not confirmed)**: also from #central-random. Tobias filed it on 13 Oct under "Tobias's dealer account," not under Marrow Fieldworks by name. Moss's digest says Fieldworks changed hands on 5 Jan, so it could be the same account. Nothing I can see confirms that, so I suggested she check with Tobias.

I left out PD-4821 and FR-882 because they belong to Marrow Agrisupply, a different account, and I told her why. No other Moss notes she can see mention Fieldworks. Nothing else turned up in this week's messages in her channels or our DM.

I only searched channels she belongs to and files anyone can read, and I didn't use the company-wide message search. Ticket numbers count as operational facts, not finance figures, so sharing them needed no approval.
